message.content: Based on the conversation, Wolfgang prefers a well-done meat patty in a burger because he believes it is "just safer and more flavorful." He appreciates the char that comes with a well-done patty and enjoys the juiciness and overall taste. In contrast, he values the juicy texture of a medium-rare patty, which he associates with a higher level of flavor. This preference highlights Wolfgang's focus on the safety and richness of flavors in his culinary experiences.
